name: io.github.xvcache/xvcache
title: XVcache
description: Timestamp MCP: V/X checks + PDF report. Qualified timestamps issued by Certigna, not by XVcache.

environmentVariables.name: XVCACHE_VAULT
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the Markdown vault (directory of .md notes)

environmentVariables.name: XVCACHE_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to the JSONL journal file; must stay outside the vault

environmentVariables.name: XVCACHE_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional folder for pending queue, batches and proofs (default: .xvcache next to the journal)

environmentVariables.name: XVCACHE_TSA_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: freetsa (default, not qualified), certigna (qualified eIDAS), custom, or off

environmentVariables.name: XVCACHE_TSA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional RFC 3161 endpoint override (required for custom)

environmentVariables.name: XVCACHE_TSA_USER
environmentVariables.description: TSA user account for HTTP Basic auth (Certigna Horodatage user account)

environmentVariables.name: XVCACHE_TSA_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: TSA password for HTTP Basic auth

environmentVariables.name: XVCACHE_TSA_CA_FILE
environmentVariables.description: PEM root/chain used to verify TSA token signatures with openssl

environmentVariables.name: XVCACHE_OTS
environmentVariables.description: on (default) or off: OpenTimestamps anchoring of each batch root
